An everyday staple of seaside villages, the secret to its delicious flavor lies in crab fat.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Crab Risottos are made in [[Cooking Pot]]s using [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goat Butter]], [[Rock Salt]], and any type of [[Crab]] in {{BotW}}. Regular Crab Risotto can only be made by either using two different types of Crabs or by using a fifth [[Ingredient]] with a contradictory effect. Eating one will restore six of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s, but they can also be sold for 70 [[Rupee]]s. They are known to be a staple of [[Lurelin Village|seaside villages]], and the secret to their delicious flavor comes from Crab fat. Due to the three different types of Crabs available, there are three variations of Crab Risotto: * '''Energizing Crab Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Crab Risotto}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
An everyday staple of seaside villages, the secret to its delicious flavor lies in crab fat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using a [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]. When eaten, they refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They also heal four of his Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Mighty Crab Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Crab Risotto}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
An everyday staple of seaside villages, the secret to its delicious flavor lies in crab fat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using a [[Razorclaw Crab]]. If eaten, Link's attacks will be more powerful. They also heal seven of his Hearts and are worth 40 Rupees when sold. * '''Tough Crab Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Crab Risotto}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
An everyday staple of seaside villages, the secret to its delicious flavor lies in crab fat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using an [[Ironshell Crab]]. Consuming one will temporarily boost Link's defensive abilities. In addition, they heal four Hearts and sell for 40 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Crab Risottos are made in [[Cooking Pot]]s or [[Portable Pot]]s using [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goat Butter]], [[Rock Salt]], and any type of [[Crab]] in {{TotK}}. They are identical to their {{BotW|-}} incarnation. When eaten, they will restore [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]], or they can be sold for [[Rupee]]s.{{How Many}} Crab Risottos are the eighty-third entry in the [[Recipe Book]]. Due to the three different types of Crabs available, there are three variations of Crab Risotto: * '''Energizing Crab Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Crab Risotto}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
An everyday staple of seaside villages, the secret to its delicious flavor lies in crab fat.|Inventory|TotK}} Made using a [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]. When eaten, they refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They also heal four of his Hearts and sell for 25 Rupees. * '''Mighty Crab Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Crab Risotto}}
